## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Mir liegt etwas auf dem Herzen.** — [meer leekt ET-vas owf daym HAIR-tsen] — *Something is weighing on my heart.*
2. **Das kommt mir spanisch vor.** — [das kommt meer SHPAH-nish for] — *That seems fishy to me. (lit. "That seems Spanish to me")*
3. **Ich bin ganz bei dir.** — [ish bin gants by deer] — *I'm completely with you. / I fully support you.*
